name: Phantom Lawyer
description: A timid lawyer who suddenly gains the ability to see ghosts teams up with a cold, elite attorney, and together they take on supernatural clients whose unfinished business reveals buried truths.

videos.title: A Haunted Law Office
videos.overview: Rejected by law firms, Shin I-rang rents an eerie old office and lands his first job: a medical malpractice case for a ghost and his grieving wife.

videos.title: An Unholy Alliance
videos.overview: After ghostly client Lee Gang-pung possesses him, I-rang reconsiders their arrangement — until a crisis renews his conviction.

videos.title: Death Of High School Girl
videos.overview: The ghost of a teenage girl haunts I-rang in his office, demanding he acknowledge her existence and find out who she was.

videos.title: Harmony of the Dead
videos.overview: I-rang vows to reveal the true perpetrator behind Su-a's case. With this in mind, he enters a temporary alliance with his lawyer nemesis, Na-hyun.

videos.title: Guilty Or Innocent?
videos.overview: I-rang's new case involves a gifted scientist who died at the hands of his wife. The wife's defense lawyer turns out to be none other than Na-hyun.

videos.title: New Suspect
videos.overview: Mistakenly linked to a murder, I-rang must race against time to solve the case and prove his innocence.

videos.title: Na-hyun's Past
videos.overview: When I-rang loses his ability to see ghosts and Na-hyun suffers a career setback, the two cross paths again at the courthouse.

videos.title: I-rang Meets So-hyun
videos.overview: A possessed I-rang acts out at a crime scene and gets arrested. While locked up, he discovers the identity of the ghost who caused his outburst.

videos.title: Na-hyun's Family
videos.overview: Na-hyun spends precious time with her sister thanks to I-rang. But her emotional wounds deepen behind the facade of a happy family reunion.

videos.title: The Secret Of I-rang's Old Friend
videos.overview: I-rang and Na-hyun officially launch their partnership. On their first day, a vegetable vendor arrives at their office seeking legal help.

videos.title: Seon-hwa's Past
videos.overview: Attorney Yang Do-kyung complicates Na-hyun's case. I-rang and his partner bond and uncover crucial evidence that couldturn the trial in their favor.

videos.title: The Missing Child
videos.overview: I-rang discovers the tragic truth behind a child's death. Meanwhile, Do-kyung seethes with jealousy as he realizes Na-hyun's heart belongs to another.

videos.title: The Truth Revealed
videos.overview: After a violent encounter leaves I-rang in a critical state, a desperate Na-hyun confesses a secret as she stands by his side.

videos.title: The Past Of My Father
videos.overview: The ghost of I-rang's father appears, unaware of the heartache he caused his son. Can they find a way to overcome their painful past?

videos.title: The Truth Of Gi-jung's Death
videos.overview: As l-rang learns a shocking truth from his father, Do-kyung adds pressure and pushes him toward a breaking point.

videos.title: The Final Confrontation
videos.overview: To solve his father's case, I-rang secures a key piece of evidence. But when a new threat jeopardizes his findings, he makes a dangerous gamble.
